description: Enterprise techniques used by POLLBLEND, ATT&CK software S9066 (v1.0)
name: POLLBLEND (S9066)

techniques.comment: [POLLBLEND](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9066) communicates with hardcoded C2 using HTTP POST Requests.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[POLLBLEND](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9066) has exfiltrated the victim device’s username and computer name within the JSON body through HTTP POST requests to the URI pathway `/register/`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[POLLBLEND](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9066) has been executed using DLL search order hijacking.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[POLLBLEND](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9066) has utilized hardcoded C2 communications to download configuration data.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[POLLBLEND](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9066) has utilized valid digital signatures to evade detection from security tools.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
